'''FC Shinnik Yaroslavl''' ({{langx|ru|Футбольный клуб «Шинник» Ярославль}}) is a Russian [[association football|football]] club, based in [[Yaroslavl]].

From 1957 to 1960 the team was called '''Khimik''' ({{langx|ru|Химик}} - "the chemist"). In 1961, the club became affiliated with the {{Ill|Yaroslavl Tyre Factory|ru|Ярославский шинный завод}}, accordingly changing its name and logo (a football inside a tyre) until the 1990s.

In the USSR championships, the team has played 1346 matches (523 wins, 376 draws, 447 defeats), with a goal difference of 1652:1499 (+153)."}}
